name: tech-career-reviewer
description: Evidence-based career reviews for technology professionals

interface.shortDescription: Review tech CVs, profiles, and portfolios
interface.longDescription: Review CVs, LinkedIn profiles, portfolios, and target-job alignment for software engineering, QA, product management, and product design without inventing candidate claims.
